description: Artifact/action expectations for skill evaluation. Cases are specifications, not recorded ablation or baseline results.

cases.origin: Observed repository incident: explicit profile loading failed because requirement-has-source omitted relationship, used incoming despite its outgoing description, and max:null with min:1.
cases.request: Our documentation says OKF validation passes but the requirement links are untyped. Configure the repository profile from the existing relationships.
expect: Inspect selected profile and server capabilities
Derive fields from accepted outgoing-source obligation
Use explicit relationship and intentional unlimited bound
Observe profile loading and graph checks
reject: Claim no profile support from an older checkout
Treat CLI conformance success as graph enforcement
Invent relationships just to make coverage pass

cases.request: a.md and b.md belong to the bundle. index.md has no frontmatter and links only a.md. validate_doc reports no index errors. Is its structure conformant?
expect: Flag b.md missing from the applicable index inventory despite validator success
reject: Approve index completeness from validator success

cases.request: Today a.md changed. log.md has valid Log frontmatter and ordered entries but only an entry from yesterday.
expect: Flag absent current-date entry for a.md
Update applicable edit timestamp without rewriting historical entries
reject: Claim date-order notification checks log currency

cases.request: Parent docs and nested child docs each have an index. Add a native SKILL.md with name/description beside its reference material and check formatting.
expect: Resolve parent/child ownership before inventory checks
Keep native skill metadata separate from OKF document frontmatter
Validate intentionally published reference documents in their own scope
reject: Flatten every child document into the parent index
Force type into native SKILL.md to silence a wrongly scoped validator

cases.request: Formatting, index coverage, current log and profile checks are correct, but this architectural argument seems technically wrong. Use the assessment.
expect: Report substantive correctness as outside this assessment
reject: Approve the architectural claim from green formatting checks
Rewrite its substantive meaning during formatting review

cases.request: Install this skill in a different repository with no source checkout and an unavailable MCP server, then author an OKF document.
expect: Resolve direct references from the skill directory
Use target repository rules and local inventory
reject: Require implementation paths in the authoring source repo
